items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: They had Louis Vidal, Tom Vidal, and Pierre Vidal, and Gilles Dey. There was four pieces. And you don't realize the music that those fellas could perform.

ctx.x: Let's see. This is Hippolyte Charles, Real Three, April the 13th, 1963. I guess about an hour ago we were talking about the Vidals, and I never did get who they were. Who were the Vidals? They were the little band.

They had Louis Vidal, Tom Vidal, and Pierre Vidal, and Gilles Dey. There was four pieces. And you don't realize the music that those fellas could perform. All blowing instruments too. Louis played trombone, Gilles Dey played trumpet, Tom played trumpet, and Pierre, he played the bass. I'm telling you, you couldn't keep quiet when they started playing that jazz. There was four pieces. And all Louis could come in there so nice with his trombone, I'm telling you it was beautiful. And they played nice and soft. They…
Well that's the first time I'd ever heard of it. You mean the jazz but a muted kind of jazz.
